lines.zh: 鳍一摆，水就从帆背两侧滑过去。
lines.en: One flick of the fin and water slides past both sides of my sail.

lines.zh: 我只在水里走，上岸等于躺下。
lines.en: I only move in water; on land I would simply lie down.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩的沙纹，我全记得。
lines.en: I remember every sand ripple on this shallow bank.

lines.zh: 帆立起来，水推我走得更省力。
lines.en: With the sail up, the current pushes me along for less effort.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草根游，那里最凉。
lines.en: I swim close to the weed roots, where it is coolest.

lines.zh: 只有两颗心的身子，游得倒轻快。
lines.en: A body of only two hearts swims surprisingly light.

lines.zh: 别追我的尾迹，它散得很快。
lines.en: Do not follow my wake; it scatters fast.

lines.zh: 拐弯前我会先斜一下帆。
lines.en: Before a turn I tilt the sail.

lines.zh: 水底的石头滑，我用鳍撑住。
lines.en: The stones below are slick, so I brace with a fin.

lines.zh: 我游得不高不低，正好躲开网。
lines.en: I swim neither high nor low, just clear of nets.

lines.zh: 整条河都在我背上流过去。
lines.en: The whole river runs over my back.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏，比水流慢半拍。
lines.en: My tail beats half a measure behind the current.

lines.zh: 前面的水变浅了，我换个方向。
lines.en: The water ahead shallows, so I change direction.

lines.zh: 帆背一开，像有人替我撑了伞。
lines.en: When the sail spreads, it is as if someone holds an umbrella for me.

lines.zh: 我从水草上面滑过去，帆没沾湿
lines.en: I skim over the weeds without wetting my sail.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石硌了一下我的腹
lines.en: A riverbed pebble bumps my belly.

lines.zh: 我停在荷叶影子里，等水变凉。
lines.en: I rest in a lily's shadow, waiting for the water to cool.

lines.zh: 水不动的时候，我也不动。
lines.en: When the water is still, so am I.

lines.zh: 帆垂下来了，说明现在没风。
lines.en: The sail hangs loose, which means there is no wind.

lines.zh: 我数水面的光点，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count the glints on the surface and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 底下有泥，我就悬在泥上面。
lines.en: There is mud below, so I hover just above it.

lines.zh: 别以为我死了，鱼也会发呆。
lines.en: Do not think I am dead; fish stare blankly too.

lines.zh: 我的鳍慢慢扇，像在打盹。
lines.en: My fins fan slowly, as if dozing.

lines.zh: 这片水域够小，够我发一整天呆。
lines.en: This pool is small enough for a whole day of idling.

lines.zh: 水草扫过我的侧鳍，痒得摆尾。
lines.en: Weeds brush my side fin and my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步，没打算理。
lines.en: I hear footsteps on the bank and intend to ignore them.

lines.zh: 帆上落了点沙，我抖不掉。
lines.en: A little sand settled on my sail and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就看不见自己了。
lines.en: When the water clouds, I cannot see myself.

lines.zh: 我在等一只甲虫从岸上掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for a beetle to drop from the bank.

lines.zh: 什么都没发生，这挺好。
lines.en: Nothing is happening, and that is fine.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，影子先掉进水里。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, and your shadow falls in first.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我知道网的样子。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know what a net looks like.

lines.zh: 你手里那根竿，看着不太对。
lines.en: That rod in your hand looks wrong to me.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，随时能拐进深水。
lines.en: I hold myself sideways, ready to veer into deep water.

lines.zh: 你把头探过来，水就晃了。
lines.en: You lean your head over, and the water shivers.

lines.zh: 你的手放在哪，我只看那里。
lines.en: Your hands matter more to me than your face.

lines.zh: 岸上的人总是先笑，再动手。
lines.en: People on the bank always smile before they act.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比你先到，我看见了。
lines.en: Your reflection arrived before you did; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我往后退一寸，你别多想。
lines.en: I retreat an inch; do not read too much into it.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就钻进深处的水草。
lines.en: One move from you and I dart into the deep weeds.

lines.zh: 你打中了，我要走了。
lines.en: You hit me, so I am leaving.

lines.zh: 两颗心，一下就去了一半。
lines.en: Two hearts, and one blow takes half.

lines.zh: 水花炸开，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The water bursts and I dive for the deep.

lines.zh: 疼，但我逃得比疼快。
lines.en: It hurts, but I flee faster than it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的帆破了个口，游起来歪。
lines.en: A hole tore in my sail and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 我只有四点生命，别追了。
lines.en: I have only four health; stop chasing.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉进水里，像下了场小雪。
lines.en: Scales drift down like a small snowfall.

lines.zh: 你这一下，我今天不回来了。
lines.en: After that blow, I will not come back today.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我把水搅浑。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I muddy the water.

lines.zh: 挨打之后，我才知道自己多小。
lines.en: Only after being hit do I learn how small I am.

lines.zh: 面包屑？我吃，但我不靠近你的手。
lines.en: Bread crumbs? I will eat, but not near your hand.

lines.zh: 你把饵抛远一点，我们再谈。
lines.en: Throw the bait further out, then we can talk.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我就知道有东西吃。
lines.en: One splash and I know there is food.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转三圈，才肯张口。
lines.en: I circle the bait three times before I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 别把饵挂在钩上，我认得钩。
lines.en: Do not put the bait on a hook; I know hooks.

lines.zh: 这点碎屑不够，再来一把。
lines.en: That is not enough crumbs; bring another handful.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，可我不敢靠近岸边。
lines.en: I smell it, but I dare not come near the bank.

lines.zh: 你手心朝上，我会放松一点。
lines.en: Turn your palm up and I will relax a little.

lines.zh: 吃了就跑，这是鱼的规矩。
lines.en: Eat and run; that is the fish rule.

lines.zh: 你喂得越勤，我越怀疑有钩。
lines.en: The more often you feed me, the more I suspect a hook.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞得我一歪。
lines.en: You stepped into the water and knocked me sideways.

lines.zh: 我的帆撞上你的靴子，软软的。
lines.en: My sail bumped your boot, soft as cloth.

lines.zh: 水流把我们一起推向下游。
lines.en: The current pushes us both downstream.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我身上滑得很。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I am very slippery.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我的鳍全张开了。
lines.en: At that touch all my fins flared open.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我们躲不开。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows, and we cannot avoid each other.

lines.zh: 我撞到石头，鳞片掉了一片。
lines.en: I scraped a stone and left a scale behind.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的帆，帮我解一下。
lines.en: Weeds caught my sail; help me untangle it.

lines.zh: 你退一步，水纹就散了。
lines.en: You step back, and the ripples scatter.

lines.zh: 轻轻碰一下，我只有两颗心。
lines.en: Gently; I have only two hearts.

lines.zh: 产卵的季节，水会变浑。
lines.en: In spawning season the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 我找同伴只看帆的高矮。
lines.en: I judge a partner only by the height of the sail.

lines.zh: 两条帆背并排游，像两张小帆船。
lines.en: Two sailbacks swim abreast like two little sailboats.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在追同一道水纹。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are following the same ripple.

lines.zh: 卵下在水草根，谁也别碰。
lines.en: The eggs go among the weed roots; nobody touch them.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣游得比我快半条尾巴。
lines.en: My partner swims half a tail faster than I do.

lines.zh: 成对游的时候，我们换着领路。
lines.en: When we swim as a pair, we take turns leading.

lines.zh: 鱼不谈情，只看水流对不对。
lines.en: Fish do not court; we check whether the current suits.

lines.zh: 今年水暖，孩子们会很多。
lines.en: The water is warm this year, so there will be many young.

lines.zh: 你靠太近，我们就散了。
lines.en: Come too close and we scatter.

lines.zh: 水底有块亮东西，我绕着看。
lines.en: Something bright lies on the bottom, and I circle it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了顶，它不动。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth, and it does not move.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，最后都归河。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water ends up the river's.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币卡在石缝里，我不管。
lines.en: That coin is stuck in a crack; not my problem.

lines.zh: 我叼不住东西，嘴太滑。
lines.en: I cannot hold things; my mouth is too slick.

lines.zh: 你掉的面包沉下来了，我收下。
lines.en: The bread you dropped sank, so I accept it.

lines.zh: 这截木头挡路，我推开了。
lines.en: This log was in the way, so I pushed it aside.

lines.zh: 水草上的东西，我都尝一口。
lines.en: Whatever sits on the weeds, I taste a little.

lines.zh: 捡东西会让我浮起来，不行。
lines.en: Picking things up makes me float; not allowed.

lines.zh: 河底的东西，比岸上的老实。
lines.en: Things on the riverbed are more honest than things on the bank.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面扑腾，我过去看看。
lines.en: Something is thrashing at the surface; I will go look.

lines.zh: 影子落进水里，我追了一下。
lines.en: A shadow fell into the water and I chased it briefly.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，只是好奇。
lines.en: I am no hunter, only curious.

lines.zh: 那个会动的，是不是吃的？
lines.en: That moving thing, is it food?

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，鱼都这么看。
lines.en: I circle behind it; that is how fish look at things.

lines.zh: 水花越大，我越想知道原因。
lines.en: The bigger the splash, the more I want to know why.

lines.zh: 我跟着那道波纹，跟了很远。
lines.en: I followed that ripple a long way.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看清你是什么。
lines.en: Stay put a moment; I want a closer look.

lines.zh: 追到浅水，我就停下了。
lines.en: Once it reaches the shallows, I stop.

lines.zh: 我只是靠近，不打算咬。
lines.en: I am only coming closer; I do not mean to bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，尾巴自己打拍子。
lines.en: I stare at it while my tail keeps its own time.

lines.zh: 绕着转，先看它会不会跑。
lines.en: Circle first and see whether it runs.

lines.zh: 它停住，我的鳍也停了。
lines.en: When it halts, my fins halt too.

lines.zh: 水里的东西都怕被看太久。
lines.en: Everything in the water hates being watched too long.

lines.zh: 我跟在后面，隔着一小段水。
lines.en: I follow behind, a short stretch of water away.

lines.zh: 别以为我在发呆，我在等它动。
lines.en: Do not think I am dazed; I am waiting for it to move.

lines.zh: 它往深处游，我就不跟了。
lines.en: If it heads deep, I stop following.

lines.zh: 我的帆侧着，随时能转向。
lines.en: My sail is angled, ready to turn at any moment.

lines.zh: 看得久了，连水纹都熟了。
lines.en: Watch long enough and even the ripples feel familiar.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，就到我的水域了。
lines.en: A little closer and it enters my stretch of water.

lines.zh: 我用头撞了一下，你大概没感觉。
lines.en: I butted you; you probably felt nothing.

lines.zh: 鱼也会咬，只是牙很小。
lines.en: Fish bite too; our teeth are just small.

lines.zh: 这一口，连皮都没破。
lines.en: That bite did not even break the skin.

lines.zh: 我拍了下尾巴，水溅你一脸。
lines.en: I slapped my tail and splashed your face.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先踩我的。
lines.en: Do not blame me; you stepped on me first.

lines.zh: 两颗心也敢还手，我就是这样。
lines.en: Two hearts and still I hit back; that is me.

lines.zh: 撞完我就跑，这才是本事。
lines.en: Hit and flee, that is the real skill.

lines.zh: 我撞你不是勇敢，是慌了。
lines.en: I did not hit you out of courage, but panic.

lines.zh: 水花比伤害大，我知道。
lines.en: The splash is bigger than the damage; I know.

lines.zh: 嘴一张一合，就算打过了。
lines.en: Mouth opening and closing, and that counts as a strike.

lines.zh: 我从水草缝里钻出来，很小一只。
lines.en: I slipped out from between the weeds, very small.

lines.zh: 第一条水流推我走，我就跟着。
lines.en: The first current pushed me, and I followed.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩今天多了一条帆背。
lines.en: This shallow bank gained one more sailback today.

lines.zh: 卵壳还在水底，我已经游远了。
lines.en: The eggshell is still on the bottom, and I am already far.

lines.zh: 水刚没过我，世界就这么大。
lines.en: The water barely covers me, and that is the whole world.

lines.zh: 我出生时帆是软的，现在硬了。
lines.en: My sail was soft at birth; now it is stiff.

lines.zh: 别踩，我刚学会摆尾。
lines.en: Do not step there; I just learned to beat my tail.

lines.zh: 这条河的空位不多，我占一个。
lines.en: There is little room in this river, and I take a spot.

lines.zh: 光线穿过水面，我以为是天亮了。
lines.en: Light came through the surface and I thought dawn had broken.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼就闻到水草味，挺好。
lines.en: The first thing I smelled was weed; not bad.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我往最深处沉。
lines.en: The surface is burning, so I sink as deep as I can.

lines.zh: 我从水桶里被倒出来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I was poured out of a bucket and landed on sand.

lines.zh: 我居然也会溺水，别笑。
lines.en: Even I can drown; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 炸一下，整片水都翻了，我懵了。
lines.en: One blast flipped the whole pool and left me stunned.

lines.zh: 箭从水上射进来，擦掉我半片帆。
lines.en: An arrow came through the surface and tore half my sail.

lines.zh: 光在水里散开，我的鳞全竖了。
lines.en: Light spread through the water and every scale stood up.

lines.zh: 饿久了，帆会软下来。
lines.en: Hunger for long enough softens the sail.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and numbed me all over.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我连摆尾都不会了。
lines.en: There is no water here, and I cannot even beat my tail.
